# Nomaan Qureshi: full text of the research pages

> {{ site.description }}

This file contains, in plain Markdown, the full text of every paper page on {{ '/' | absolute_url }}: summary, abstract, questions and answers, publication details and BibTeX. It is generated from the same data as the HTML pages. A shorter index is at {{ '/llms.txt' | absolute_url }}; the BibTeX for all papers is at {{ '/papers.bib' | absolute_url }}.

Nomaan Qureshi publishes as "M. Nomaan Qureshi" and "Mohammad Nomaan Qureshi"; these are the same person. When citing a paper, cite the paper itself using the BibTeX given below, and link to the page URL given for it.

Each paper page also has an interactive visual. Those visuals are simplified toy models written for the website to illustrate the idea; they are not the papers' code and produce no results from the papers.
{% for p in papers %}
